main_result: The same full dual-port reference parent gives conditional right-role selection, optional multiplicity matching, actual finite cross-port coherence and a nonredundant shared-reference curvature constraint on isospectral relative flavor orientation, with common exact handoff and complete sources.
scope_limits: The K>=4 equivariant role conclusion requires complete unknown reference/port/partner inputs, not separately tested ports.
Trivial copies remain family multiplicities; equal multiplicities follow only with the optional full-coverage contract.
The coherent product reference task has different initial quantifiers from the full unknown fixed-K task.
The complete K<=L+2 parent retains vacuum, low boundaries, transverse branches and highest occupation.
The shared Gram budget is necessary and sufficient only for the declared initial reference-leakage curvature task; Duhamel is not reversed.
The illustrative budget is an input, not a natural constant or empirical mixing prediction; both isospectral examples meet the original common-clock handoff.
Each candidate keeps its own complete sources; identical source values are not assumed.
This finite single-fermion reference model is not a local Higgs field, a physical mass-pole reconstruction or a complete standard-model realization.
